21001.name: Pathway To The Lost Castle
21001.description:
A narrow shaft from above opens into a tangled cavern of braced sticks.
The maze stretches into darkness. Darkness clings to every surface. The
stone walls press close, cold and damp.

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel Of Sticks.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To The Lost Castle.

21063.name: The Tunnel Of Sticks
21063.description:
Twisted roots and splintered timbers brace the earthen walls, forming a
claustrophobic maze of sticks and shadow. The air is damp and still. The
stone walls press close, cold and damp. The air is thick and hard to
breathe.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel Of Sticks.

up.description: To the up lies Outside The Great Forest Of MiNar.

21010.name: mosquito
21010.long_desc: A mosquito the size of a thumb hovers here, its wings whining.

21011.name: stick stalker
21011.long_desc: A lean cavern hunter draped in bark and bone stalks the tunnels.

21098.name: terrified traveler
21098.long_desc: A terrified traveler cowers here behind a pile of debris, eyes wide with panic.
21098.description: They're shaking uncontrollably, covered in scratches from the stick-like creatures that infest these tunnels. Their pack has been torn to shreds and their torch is nearly spent.

talk_responses.hello: The traveler grabs you with frantic hands. 'The sticks! They MOVE! I thought they were just branches but they came alive and — there are hundreds of them! They fear fire, FIRE is the only thing that stops them! Please, do you have a torch? A spell? Anything? I just want to get OUT!'
talk_responses.sticks: They whimper. 'They blend with the walls. You can't tell what's tunnel and what's creature until it's too late. Listen for clicking — that's how they communicate. If the clicking gets fast, they're about to attack. Go slow and burn everything suspicious.'
talk_responses.default: The traveler flinches at every sound, clutching a spent torch like a lifeline.
talk_responses.next: The traveler stares at you with wild eyes. 'You've reached the end of the known world, adventurer. There is nothing beyond this place but legend. You ARE the legend now.'

21050.name: portable hole
21050.room_desc: A dark, folded disk of nothingness lies here.
21050.description: A rare portable hole capable of holding an enormous amount of gear.
